points.t: Rippled grey-brown interscapular pigment, or itchy firm brown papules on the shins, in someone who scrubs or scratches.
Damaged keratinocytes → keratin-derived amyloid in the papillary dermis.
Stop friction and scratching, potent steroid ± occlusion, emollients, treat itch; refer if refractory or unsure.
Systemic amyloidosis signs (purpura, macroglossia, nephrotic syndrome) are a different disease: refer.

points: Amyloid: chronic scratching/friction deposits keratin-derived amyloid in the papillary dermis.
